scope: Architecture and priorities only; no sector requirement packages implemented.
promotion_gates: Applicable official evidence and AM-07 source records at activity date
Standards incorporation or contractual basis and authorized text access
Delta requirements only; no duplicated core formula or procedure
Qualified source/applicability review with conflicts preserved
Positive, missing-evidence, conflicting-source and unsupported-scope scenarios
Observed behavior recorded separately from structural checks
Governance/licence and release checks appropriate to intended distribution
priority_basis: Project sequencing judgment based on existing core handoffs and scope prerequisites; not market demand, legal urgency, budget, staffing or delivery commitment.
conflict_rule: Preserve conflicting requirements with scope, source, effective date and reviewer; never select the easiest rule or assume a broad parent overrides a specific evidenced requirement.
generic_rule: Missing sector coverage limits only sector-dependent conclusions; compatible generic analysis may proceed.

priorities.rationale: Existing process-routing and quality packages offer a bounded first composition; welding remains a separate conditional question.
Existing change and machinery-review packages provide concrete evidence handoffs without design approval.
Parameter-control and substitution evidence provide a bounded core-to-sector test.
Existing BOM and process-change methods support focused assembly evidence; electrical-equipment scope needs separation.
Cross-sector composition should be proven after one product-sector context; qualification evidence is an explicit gate.
Define broad scope before composing specific automotive or aerospace requirements.
Customer/product scope and requirement provenance need a dedicated brief before authoring.
Product/program and review-authority evidence need a dedicated brief before authoring.
Product/process scope and qualified source review must precede requirement authoring.
Intended use, market and qualified scope research must precede requirement authoring.
Supplier/workplace/product roles and process limits require a separately scoped source review.
Resolve the umbrella into wood-products and/or pulp-paper before selecting a requirements package.
